karinca.name: Karınca
karinca.desc: a cute small cartoon ANT INSECT (not a human, not a girl): round red-brown insect head with two antennae, big shiny eyes, six thin insect legs, segmented glossy ant body, tiny blue cap and a small backpack

agustos.name: Ağustos Böceği
agustos.desc: a funny cartoon GRASSHOPPER INSECT (not a human): bright green insect body, long folded jumping legs, two long antennae, big goofy eyes, tiny straw hat, holding a small wooden violin

tavsan.name: Tavşan
tavsan.desc: an arrogant fast cartoon white rabbit with long ears, smug half-closed eyes, wearing red sneakers and a tiny sports headband

kaplumbaga.name: Kaplumbağa
kaplumbaga.desc: a calm wise old cartoon tortoise with a big green patterned shell, kind smile, tiny round glasses and a little blue scarf

tilki.name: Tilki
tilki.desc: a sly skinny cartoon orange fox with a bushy white-tipped tail, sharp clever eyes and a tiny purple vest

aslan.name: Aslan
aslan.desc: a huge proud cartoon lion with a giant fluffy golden mane, big paws and a tiny golden crown

fare.name: Fare
fare.desc: a tiny brave cartoon grey mouse with huge round pink ears, big sparkling eyes and a little red bow tie

coban.name: Çoban Çocuk
coban.desc: a mischievous 10-year-old shepherd boy with messy brown hair, freckles, gap-toothed grin, wearing a brown vest, white shirt and holding a wooden shepherd staff

koylu.name: Köylüler
koylu.desc: a group of funny chubby village farmers, men and women with mustaches and headscarves, holding pitchforks and shovels

beats.say: Yaz boyu çalışan bir karınca ve *hiç* çalışmayan bir ağustos böceği… Sonu seni şaşırtacak!
beats.img: {karinca} carrying a huge wheat grain while {agustos} lies in a hammock playing violin, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Karınca kardeş, bu sıcakta çalışılır mı? Gel biraz *müzik* yapalım!
beats.img: {agustos} playing the violin with eyes closed, dancing, close-up, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Kış gelecek böcek kardeş. Şimdi çalışmazsam kışın *aç* kalırım.
beats.img: {karinca} wiping sweat from forehead, carrying grain, serious face, close-up, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Ağustos böceği güler geçer. Bütün yaz şarkı söyler, dans eder.
beats.img: {agustos} dancing wildly on top of a giant mushroom with musical notes in the air, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Derken… soğuk rüzgârlar eser ve *kar* yağmaya başlar.
beats.img: {agustos} shivering with icicles on his hat, alone in the snow, in a snowy cold winter forest with frozen trees

beats.say: Brrr! Açım, üşüyorum… Karınca kardeş, kapını açar mısın?
beats.img: {agustos} knocking on a tiny cozy wooden door of an anthill glowing with warm light, sad face, in a snowy cold winter forest with frozen trees

beats.say: Karınca kapıyı açar. İçerisi sıcacık, sofra *yemek* dolu!
beats.img: {karinca} opening the door, warm cozy room full of food behind, in a snowy cold winter forest with frozen trees

beats.say: Gel içeri. Ama bu yaz bana yardım edeceksin, söz mü?
beats.img: {karinca} smiling and inviting {agustos} inside next to a fireplace, in a snowy cold winter forest with frozen trees

beats.say: Ders: Bugünün emeği, yarının *sofrasıdır*. Daha fazla masal için takip et!
beats.img: {karinca} and {agustos} eating soup together by the fireplace laughing, cozy, in a snowy cold winter forest with frozen trees

publish.title: Karınca ile Ağustos Böceği 🐜🎻 Sonu Şaşırtıcı! #shorts
publish.description: Ezop'un ünlü masalı animasyonla: Çalışkan karınca ve tembel ağustos böceği. Kısa, komik ve öğretici bir masal.

beats.say: Dünyanın en hızlı tavşanı, en yavaş kaplumbağaya *yarış* teklif eder!
beats.img: {tavsan} pointing and laughing at {kaplumbaga} at a start line with a ribbon, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Ha ha! Sen mi? Ben bitişe varınca sen daha *başlamamış* olursun!
beats.img: {tavsan} posing arrogantly flexing tiny muscles, close-up, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Görürüz tavşan kardeş. Acele eden *yolda* kalır.
beats.img: {kaplumbaga} smiling calmly adjusting his glasses, close-up, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Yarış başlar! Tavşan rüzgâr gibi fırlar, toz duman olur ortalık.
beats.img: {tavsan} running super fast leaving a big dust cloud, {kaplumbaga} slowly walking, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Yolun yarısında tavşan durur. Arkasına bakar, kaplumbağa *görünmüyor* bile.
beats.img: {tavsan} under a big shady tree looking back with binoculars, smug, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Biraz kestireyim bari. Nasılsa *kazandım*.
beats.img: {tavsan} yawning and lying down under the tree, eyes closing, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Kaplumbağa ise hiç durmadan, adım adım ilerler… ve tavşanın *yanından* geçer.
beats.img: {kaplumbaga} slowly walking past the sleeping {tavsan} who is snoring with Z letters, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Tavşan uyandığında çok geçtir. Kaplumbağa bitiş çizgisini geçmiştir!
beats.img: {tavsan} waking up in panic with eyes popping, {kaplumbaga} crossing a finish line with confetti in the distance, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Ders: Yavaş ama *istikrarlı* olan kazanır. Beğendiysen takip et!
beats.img: {kaplumbaga} holding a golden trophy, animals cheering, {tavsan} blushing embarrassed, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

publish.title: Tavşan Yarışı Kaybetti! 🐢🐇 Neden? #shorts
publish.description: Tavşan ile Kaplumbağa masalı animasyonla. Kibirli tavşan, sabırlı kaplumbağa ve şaşırtan son.

beats.say: Aç bir tilki, ağaçta sallanan *kocaman* üzümler görür.
beats.img: {tilki} looking up hungrily at big juicy purple grapes hanging high on a vine, drooling, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Mmm! Ne kadar tatlı görünüyorlar. Hepsi *benim* olacak!
beats.img: {tilki} licking lips with sparkling eyes, close-up, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Zıplar… ama yetişemez. Bir daha zıplar, yine olmaz!
beats.img: {tilki} jumping high with paws stretched, grapes just out of reach, funny pose, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Taşın üstüne çıkar, kuyruğunu sallar, takla atar… *Hiçbiri* işe yaramaz.
beats.img: {tilki} doing a clumsy backflip and falling on his back, dizzy stars around head, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Hıh! Zaten o üzümler *ekşi*. Ben ekşi üzüm sevmem!
beats.img: {tilki} turning away with nose up, arms crossed, pretending not to care, close-up, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Tam o sırada bir kuş üzümü koparır ve *mmm* diye yer.
beats.img: a cute blue bird eating a grape happily on the vine, {tilki} watching jealous with one eye, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

beats.say: Ders: Ulaşamadığımız şeye *kötü* demek, kendimizi kandırmaktır. Takip et, yarın yeni masal!
beats.img: {tilki} blushing embarrassed with a tiny grape falling on his head, in a magical sunny meadow with giant flowers, mushrooms and a sparkling stream

publish.title: Tilki Üzüme Neden Ekşi Dedi? 🦊🍇 #shorts
publish.description: Tilki ile Üzüm masalı animasyonla: Ulaşamadığı üzüme ekşi diyen kurnaz tilki.

beats.say: Ormanın kralı aslan uyurken, minicik bir fare *burnunun* üstüne düşer!
beats.img: tiny {fare} accidentally landing on the nose of the sleeping {aslan}, in a lush golden savanna jungle with tall grass

beats.say: Kim o?! Seni bir lokmada *yutarım*!
beats.img: {aslan} roaring angrily holding {fare} by the tail, close-up, in a lush golden savanna jungle with tall grass

beats.say: Bağışla beni kralım! Bir gün belki ben de sana *yardım* ederim.
beats.img: {fare} begging with tiny hands together and teary big eyes, close-up, in a lush golden savanna jungle with tall grass

beats.say: Aslan kahkahalarla güler. Minicik bir fare ona ne yardım edebilir ki? Onu bırakır.
beats.img: {aslan} laughing loudly and letting {fare} go, in a lush golden savanna jungle with tall grass

beats.say: Günler sonra aslan avcıların *ağına* yakalanır!
beats.img: {aslan} trapped in a big rope net hanging, roaring for help, in a lush golden savanna jungle with tall grass

beats.say: Fare kükremeyi duyar ve koşa koşa gelir. Minik dişleriyle ipleri tek tek *keser*.
beats.img: {fare} chewing through the thick ropes of the net with determination, close-up, in a lush golden savanna jungle with tall grass

beats.say: Sen… beni kurtardın küçük dostum!
beats.img: {aslan} free and amazed, bowing down to tiny {fare}, in a lush golden savanna jungle with tall grass

beats.say: Ders: Kimseyi küçük görme. En küçük dost bile *hayat* kurtarır. Takip etmeyi unutma!
beats.img: {fare} sitting proudly on {aslan}'s head wearing the tiny crown, both smiling, sunset, in a lush golden savanna jungle with tall grass

publish.title: Minik Fare Aslanı Kurtardı! 🦁🐭 #shorts
publish.description: Aslan ile Fare masalı animasyonla: Küçük ama kocaman yürekli bir fare.

beats.say: Köyün en yaramaz çocuğu, bir gün çok *tehlikeli* bir şaka yapar.
beats.img: {coban} grinning mischievously among sheep, on green hills with fluffy white sheep near a small village

beats.say: İmdaaat! Kurt geldi! Kurt *koyunları* yiyor!
beats.img: {coban} screaming with hands around mouth on top of a rock, on green hills with fluffy white sheep near a small village

beats.say: Köylüler kazma kürekle koşa koşa gelir. Ama ortada kurt *yoktur*.
beats.img: {koylu} running up the hill with pitchforks and shovels, panting, on green hills with fluffy white sheep near a small village

beats.say: Ha ha ha! Kandırdım sizi!
beats.img: {coban} laughing rolling on the grass, close-up, on green hills with fluffy white sheep near a small village

beats.say: Ertesi gün aynı şakayı bir daha yapar. Köylüler yine gelir, yine *kandırılır*.
beats.img: {koylu} angry and tired with sweaty faces, {coban} laughing behind a sheep, on green hills with fluffy white sheep near a small village

beats.say: Üçüncü gün… gerçekten *kurt* gelir!
beats.img: a big scary but cartoonish grey wolf with yellow eyes sneaking towards the sheep at dusk, on green hills with fluffy white sheep near a small village

beats.say: İmdat! Bu sefer gerçek! Kurt geldi!
beats.img: {coban} crying and screaming for help, very scared, close-up, dusk, on green hills with fluffy white sheep near a small village

beats.say: Ama köylüler ona artık *inanmaz*. Kimse gelmez.
beats.img: {koylu} ignoring the screams, covering their ears in the village at dusk

beats.say: Ders: Yalancının mumu yatsıya kadar yanar. Beğendiysen takip et!
beats.img: {coban} sad hugging one little lamb at night under the moon, on green hills with fluffy white sheep near a small village
